items.l2_text: The **engineering** marvel that is the airplane wing, with its characteristic airfoil shape – a curved upper surface and a flatter lower surface – is the primary generator of this crucial lift.
items.l1_text: 机翼是工程学上的奇迹，它具有特有的翼型形状，上表面弯曲，下表面较平，是产生这种关键升力的主要部件。

prev.l2: At the heart of this phenomenon lies the concept of **lift**, a force that perpetually battles gravity, enabling these massive machines to ascend and traverse vast distances.
prev.l1: 这一现象的核心是升力的概念，升力是一种始终与重力对抗的力，使这些庞然大物得以升空并飞越遥远的距离。

next.l2: When air flows over and under the wing, it encounters different paths.
next.l1: 当空气流过机翼上方和下方时，它所经过的路径不同。

items.l2_text: Consequently, this upper air must accelerate, leading to a decrease in its pressure, a phenomenon described by Bernoulli's principle.
items.l1_text: 因此，上方的空气必须加速，导致其压强下降，这一现象由伯努利原理所描述。

prev.l2: The air traveling over the curved upper surface is compelled to cover a greater distance in the same amount of time as the air flowing beneath the wing.
prev.l1: 流经弯曲上表面的空气，必须在与机翼下方气流相同的时间内走过更长的距离。

next.l2: Conversely, the air beneath the wing, traveling a shorter distance, moves at a slower speed, resulting in higher pressure.
next.l1: 相反，机翼下方的空气走过的距离较短，速度较慢，从而产生较高的压强。

items.l2_text: During cruise, these forces are meticulously balanced, allowing for sustained, level flight.
items.l1_text: 巡航期间，这些力被精心地平衡，从而得以持续平飞。

prev.l2: For an airplane to take off, thrust must be sufficient to overcome drag and accelerate the aircraft to a speed where the wings generate enough lift to exceed its weight.

next.l2: The successful flight of an airplane is a symphony of applied **physics** and ingenious **engineering**.
next.l1: 飞机的成功飞行是应用物理学与巧妙工程学的一曲交响乐。

items.l2_text: These surfaces, when deflected, alter the airflow patterns, creating localized changes in pressure that induce the desired movements.

prev.l2: While the basic principle of differential air pressure on a wing is fundamental, the complexity extends to the subtle shaping of control surfaces like ailerons, elevators, and rudders, which allow pilots to manipulate airflow and thus control the aircraft's pitch, roll, and yaw.

next.l2: For instance, deflecting an aileron on one wing upwards and on the other downwards causes a difference in lift between the two wings, making the airplane roll.

prev.l2: 这种非文本化的历史表达，在许多原住民社会中体现为“梦世纪”（Dreamtime）式的宇宙观叙述，其中祖先的行动与自然地貌的形成互为映射，时间并非线性推进，而是以神话事件为节点循环重启。
prev.l1: This non-textual expression of history is embodied, in many indigenous societies, in cosmological narratives of the "Dreamtime" type, in which the actions of ancestors and the formation of natural landforms mirror each other, and time does not advance linearly, but restarts cyclically with mythic events as its nodes.

next.l2: 叙事因此成为一种“言灵”式的存在——语言不仅描述世界，更建构现实。

items.l2_text: 这种“变异中的存续”机制，使文化核心得以在形式变迁中维持精神连续性。

prev.l2: 与书写文本的固化不同，每一次讲述都是对传统的再创造，讲述者根据当下语境、听众构成与社会需求，对情节进行增删或重构。

next.l2: 例如，在非洲部分部落，同一则英雄传说在战时会被强调勇气与牺牲，在丰收时节则突出与自然的和谐共生——历史由此成为可被调用的意义资源，而非僵化的事实档案。
next.l1: For example, in some tribes in Africa, the same hero legend is told in wartime with an emphasis on courage and sacrifice, and at harvest time highlights harmonious coexistence with nature; history thus becomes a resource of meaning that can be drawn upon, rather than a rigid archive of facts.

items.l2_text: 在全球化与数字化的当代，尽管书面记录与影像媒介主导了信息传播，口头叙事并未消亡，而是以新的形态回归：播客、口述史项目、非物质文化遗产保护运动，皆可视作对原始交流模式的现代回响。
items.l1_text: In the contemporary era of globalization and digitization, although written records and visual media dominate the spread of information, oral narrative has not died out, but has returned in new forms: podcasts, oral history projects and movements to protect intangible cultural heritage can all be regarded as modern echoes of the original mode of communication.

prev.l2: 例如，在非洲部分部落，同一则英雄传说在战时会被强调勇气与牺牲，在丰收时节则突出与自然的和谐共生——历史由此成为可被调用的意义资源，而非僵化的事实档案。
prev.l1: For example, in some tribes in Africa, the same hero legend is told in wartime with an emphasis on courage and sacrifice, and at harvest time highlights harmonious coexistence with nature; history thus becomes a resource of meaning that can be drawn upon, rather than a rigid archive of facts.

next.l2: 这些实践重新肯定了身体在场、声音质感与即兴互动所蕴含的认知深度——它们无法被完全转译为文字或数据。
next.l1: These practices reaffirm the cognitive depth contained in bodily presence, vocal texture and improvised interaction; they cannot be fully translated into text or data.

items.l2_text: 中国早在唐代便已广泛应用雕版印刷，宋代毕昇更首创泥活字，开启了可重复排版的技术先河。
items.l1_text: As early as the Tang dynasty, China had already widely used woodblock printing, and in the Song dynasty Bi Sheng even first invented clay movable type, opening the precedent for reusable typesetting technology.

prev.l2: 在雕版印刷与活字技术相继出现之前，知识的保存与传播极度依赖手抄本，这一过程不仅耗时费力，更易产生讹误，致使书籍成为少数精英阶层才能接触的奢侈品。
prev.l1: Before woodblock printing and movable-type technology appeared one after another, the preservation and spread of knowledge relied extremely heavily on handwritten copies, a process that was not only time-consuming and laborious but also prone to errors, causing books to become luxuries that only a small elite class could access.

next.l2: 然而，受制于汉字数量庞大、排版复杂以及社会结构的限制，这一技术未能引发大规模的知识普及浪潮。
next.l1: However, limited by the huge number of Chinese characters, the complexity of typesetting, and the constraints of social structure, this technology failed to trigger a large-scale wave of popularization of knowledge.

items.l2_text: 虽然大家没见过面，但在虚拟世界里，他们成了很好的伙伴。
items.l1_text: Although they have never met, in the virtual world they have become good partners.

prev.l1: As time goes by, their language ability will also improve.

items.l2_text: 这样就会产生一种向上的力，我们叫它“升力”。
items.l1_text: This produces an upward force, which we call "lift."

prev.l2: 翅膀上面的空气流得快，下面的空气流得慢。
prev.l1: The air above the wing flows fast, and the air below flows slowly.

next.l2: 升力让飞机离开地面，飞上天空。
next.l1: Lift makes the airplane leave the ground and fly up into the sky.

items.l2_text: 阻力会让飞机变慢。
items.l1_text: Drag makes the airplane slow down.

prev.l2: 这种挡住飞机的力叫“阻力”。
prev.l1: This force that blocks the airplane is called "drag."

next.l2: 所以飞机的形状要做得光滑，这样空气才能顺利流过，减少阻力。
next.l1: So the shape of the airplane must be made smooth, so that the air can flow past smoothly and drag is reduced.

items.l1_text: When he lets go of the toy car, the toy car starts to roll.

prev.l1: The slope is very high.

next.l1: It rolls very fast, and its speed gets faster and faster.

items.l2_text: 有的地方打鼓讲故事，有的地方跳舞讲故事。
items.l1_text: In some places they beat drums to tell stories, and in other places they dance to tell stories.

prev.l2: 每个村、每个国家都有自己的叙事方式。
prev.l1: Every village and every country has its own way of narrative.

next.l2: 故事可以教人做对的事，也可以让人开心。
next.l1: Stories can teach people to do what is right, and can also make people happy.

items.l2_text: 宗教改革让欧洲的宗教变了很多。
items.l1_text: The Reformation changed religion in Europe a great deal.

prev.l2: 这种传播对宗教改革很重要。
prev.l1: This spreading was very important for the Reformation.

next.l2: 印刷术让更多人知道新的宗教想法。
next.l1: Printing let more people know about new religious ideas.

items.l2_text: 虽然不是所有人都能立刻读书，但识字的人慢慢变多了。
items.l1_text: Although not everyone could read right away, the number of literate people slowly grew.

prev.l2: 学校越来越多，人们开始学习科学、历史和医学。
prev.l1: Schools became more and more numerous, and people began to study science, history and medicine.

next.l2: 城市里出现了书店和图书馆。
next.l1: Bookstores and libraries appeared in cities.

items.l2_text: 它让信息更容易被普通人得到。
items.l1_text: It made information easier for ordinary people to obtain.

prev.l2: 古腾堡的印刷机改变了世界。
prev.l1: Gutenberg's printing press changed the world.

next.l2: 虽然现在我们有电脑和手机，但书籍仍然是学习知识的重要方式。
next.l1: Although we now have computers and mobile phones, books are still an important way to learn knowledge.

items.l2_text: 通常，我们会使用舵机（servo motor），因为它可以精确地控制转动的角度，这对于抓取小物体会非常有用。
items.l1_text: Usually, we use servo motors, because they can precisely control the angle of rotation, which is very useful for grabbing small objects.

prev.l2: 电机就像是机械臂的“肌肉”，它可以让机械臂的各个部分转动。
prev.l1: Motors are like the robotic arm's "muscles"; they can make each part of the robotic arm turn.

next.l2: 接下来是“手”。
next.l1: Next is the "hand".

items.l2_text: 这个“手”需要能够张开和闭合，以便抓住物体。
items.l1_text: This "hand" needs to be able to open and close so that it can grab objects.

prev.l2: 接下来是“手”。
prev.l1: Next is the "hand".

next.l2: 我们可以设计一个简单的夹子，用两个小臂夹住物体。
next.l1: We can design a simple clamp that uses two small arms to clamp objects.

items.l2_text: 我们可以使用一个微控制器，比如Arduino或者Raspberry Pi。
items.l1_text: We can use a microcontroller, such as an Arduino or a Raspberry Pi.

prev.l2: 这个“大脑”就是我们的编程部分。
prev.l1: This "brain" is our programming part.

next.l2: 你需要学习一些基础的编程语言，比如C++或者Python，来编写控制代码。
next.l1: You need to learn some basic programming languages, such as C++ or Python, to write the control code.

items.l2_text: 你需要连接电机、传感器（如果需要的话，比如用来检测是否抓住了物体）和微控制器。
items.l1_text: You need to connect the motors and the microcontroller, plus sensors if needed, for example to detect whether an object has been grabbed.

prev.l2: 电子学的部分也很重要。
prev.l1: The electronics part is also very important.

next.l2: 这需要用到一些电线、电池或者电源适配器，以及可能的一些电路板。
next.l1: This requires some wires, batteries or a power adapter, and possibly some circuit boards.

items.l2_text: 叙事不只是为了娱乐，还能教人做人的道理。
items.l1_text: Narrative is not only for entertainment, but can also teach people how to be a good person.

prev.l2: 虽然这些事没有真的发生，但是人们喜欢讲它们。
prev.l1: Although these things did not really happen, people like to tell them.

next.l2: 在一些地方，长辈晚上坐在火炉边给孩子们讲故事。
next.l1: In some places, elders sit by the fire at night and tell stories to the children.

items.l2_text: 这样，大家不仅分享了故事，也分享了情感和经验。
items.l1_text: In this way, everyone shares not only the stories, but also feelings and experiences.

prev.l2: 听的人也能通过提问和讨论表达自己的看法。
prev.l1: Listeners can also express their own views through questions and discussion.

next.l2: 现在，虽然很多人通过电视和手机看故事，但还是有不少地方坚持用口头的方式讲。
next.l1: Nowadays, although many people watch stories through television and mobile phones, there are still quite a few places that insist on telling them orally.

items.l2_text: 每天晚上，我都会把它抱在怀里睡觉。
items.l1_text: Every night, I hold it in my arms and sleep.

prev.l1: This teddy bear is my good friend.

next.l1: Its eyes are black, its nose is brown, and it always looks smiling, as if it is very happy to see me.

items.l2_text: 在我伤心的时候，我会抱着它，感觉它给我带来了安慰。
items.l1_text: When I am sad, I hold it and feel that it brings me comfort.

prev.l2: 这只熊不仅仅是一个玩具，它还承载了很多我的回忆。
prev.l1: This bear is not just a toy; it also holds many of my memories.

next.l2: 在我开心的时候，我也会和它分享我的快乐。
next.l1: When I am happy, I also share my happiness with it.

items.l2_text: 每次看到它，我都会感到一种安心和快乐。
items.l1_text: Every time I see it, I feel a sense of security and happiness.

prev.l2: 它是我童年里不可缺少的一部分，也是我未来回忆里温暖的印记。
prev.l1: It is an indispensable part of my childhood, and also a warm mark in my future memories.

next.l2: 这只熊，就是我的小小的、毛绒绒的、穿着蓝色毛衣的，独一无二的朋友。
next.l1: This bear is my little, fluffy, blue-sweater-wearing, one-of-a-kind friend.

items.l2_text: 我们要听身体的话。
items.l1_text: We should listen to our bodies.

prev.l1: Yawning is not because of laziness; it is because the body needs it.

next.l2: 困了就打哈欠，然后去睡觉。
next.l1: When sleepy, yawn, and then go to sleep.
